Out of scope: fetching ratings from a public source, any override parameter, persistence, audit trail, UI, CLI or printed output, Indicator 13 as its own indicator (only its thresholds are reused), and the other POC requirements.

items.answer: Yes. Each requirement has concrete examples after the clarifications. REQ-06-02: BBB+→BB+ = 3, downgrade, WL 2; BBB+→BBB- = 2, WL 1; a 1-notch downgrade gives WL 0; upgrade or unchanged gives WL 0. REQ-03-12: 1 notch gives WL 1, 2 or more give WL 2, upgrade or unchanged gives WL 0. Invalid input throws RangeError and 'bbb+' is accepted as 'BBB+'.

(1) The REQ-06-02 example says BBB+→BB+ is 2 notches and WL 1. Resolved by C2: it is 3 notches and WL 2, because the calculator uses the Indicator 13 thresholds. (2) The calculator gives WL 0 for 1 notch while Indicator 12 gives WL 1. Resolved by C6: these are different thresholds on purpose. (3) 'Pre-filled from public source' and 'editable' are resolved by C4 and C7: the caller passes the confirmed ratings.
Both requirements are Must. countryRatingChangeWl is built on notchChange, so the src/ratings work comes first.
items.source: JOB.md 'Build only these two requirements'; Contract 'countryRatingChangeWl … built on notchChange'

items.answer: RATING_SCALE: array of the 19 C1 strings, best first (index 0 'AAA', index 18 'CCC-'). notchChange(previous, current) returns the integer index(current) − index(previous): positive means downgrade, negative means upgrade, 0 means unchanged. notchCalculator(previous, current) returns {notches (signed like notchChange), direction 'downgrade'|'upgrade'|'unchanged', wl}. wl is 0 when notches ≤ 1, 1 when notches = 2 and 2 when notches ≥ 3. countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) returns 0 when notches ≤ 0, 1 when notches = 1 and 2 when notches ≥ 2. Inputs are trimmed and case-insensitive.
items.source: Contract; C1, C2, C3, C5, C6; REQ-03-12

items.answer: Any input that is not one of the 19 ratings after trim and case-folding throws RangeError from all three functions. This covers '', '   ', 'D', 'CC', 'BBB +', 'Baa1', null, undefined and numbers. There is no fallback or default value. The message text is not part of the contract.
items.source: C1 'anything else is rejected with a RangeError'
